# Docs Sync Checklist

Use this checklist before considering any task complete.

- [ ] Change type classified (feat/fix/refactor/api/data/security/ops)
- [ ] Documentation impact matrix updated
- [ ] PRD impact documented (problem, outcome, acceptance criteria)
- [ ] ADR/ARD documented for non-trivial decisions
- [ ] Requirement docs updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Technical docs updated when architecture/contract changed
- [ ] Operational docs updated when run/deploy process changed
- [ ] At least one Mermaid diagram added to review doc
- [ ] Test docs/evidence updated
- [ ] Validation commands documented
- [ ] Containerized test evidence documented (for containerized projects)
- [ ] Risks and rollback documented
- [ ] Third-party handover checklist passed
- [ ] Review record created and linked
- [ ] Completion gate marked PASS
